Class MsgRecord

java.lang.Object
MsgRecord
public class MsgRecord extends Object
Stores the four fields found in a MSG payload: name, email, phone, comment. Parses a payload string separated by semicolons into key=value pairs. Supports normalization rules for name, email, and phone.

  • Constructor Details

    • MsgRecord

      public MsgRecord(String rawPayLoad)
      Constructs a MsgRecord by parsing the raw payload text. The payload is expected to contain four fields in any order: name, email, phone, comment. Keys and values are trimmed.
      Parameters:
      rawPayLoad - the raw payload string from a MSG log entry

    • normalize

      public MsgRecord normalize(boolean inplace)
      Normalizes name, email, and phone. If inplace is true, updates the current object. If inplace is false, returns a new normalized object.
      Parameters:
      inplace - true to modify this object, false to return a new object
      Returns:
      the normalized MsgRecord (this object or a new one)

      private String normalizeName(String n)

    • normalizeEmail

      private String normalizeEmail(String e)
      Normalizes the email by lowercasing it. If it is not a simple valid email pattern, returns INVALID_EMAIL.
      Parameters:
      e - the original email
      Returns:
      the normalized email or INVALID_EMAIL

    • normalizePhone

      private String normalizePhone(String p)
      Normalizes the phone by extracting digits. If there are 10 digits, formats as (###) ###-####. Otherwise, returns INVALID_PHONE.
      Parameters:
      p - the original phone string
      Returns:
      the formatted phone or INVALID_PHONE
